versions.changelog: v8.0.0: MEV Engine OpenClaw原生化。删除6个冗余自定义脚本，全面改用OpenClaw原生能力。MEV是驾驶手册，OpenClaw是引擎。零自定义脚本。
v7.2.1: Self-audit — Plugin Dispatch replaces manual activation table, kernel lean, 2 dead plugins removed. MEV as living self-auditing system.

v7.2: Med-Research plugin — 5-stage medical research pipeline with PRISMA/STROBE quality gates, IMRaD templates, evidence grading, and bias annotation. Extracted from OPL Research Ops + MAS domain knowledge.
Fix description to v7.1
v7.1: Stage Checkpoint plugin — five-layer receipts for durable resume + interrupt recovery. Zero new dependencies. Inspired by OPL Framework stage attempt ledger.
v7.0.0: Kernel+Plugin architecture. Core immutable, capabilities as plugins, auto-dormancy lifecycle. MEV skeleton preserved.

v6.5: Trust-but-verify. Unified preflight script (mev-prefight.cjs - 1 cmd replaces 3 gates). Agent E verification gate prevents blind trust of convergence output. IMA upload fallback path for resilience. Context budget added to G4. Inspired by multi-source-research auto-verification and deep-research-zh fault-tolerant patterns.

v6.4: Radical simplification. 2 phases, 8 mandatory gates (5 Pre-flight + 3 Delivery). Removed 15 facade capabilities discovered in v6.3 audit (9/20 unused on first task). All mandatory gates output as visible conversation blocks. No silent skip allowed. Skip requires explicit reason.
v6.3: Fully English localization. All Chinese text removed from SKILL.md for international users.

v6.3: Removed facade capabilities (ACH/Bayesian never executed - replaced with falsifiable judgment + bias quick-check). Mandatory Knowledge Gap Scan table output. Conditional iterative loop (max 2 rounds, only when >=2 high-priority gaps remain). Explicit Quality Gate STOP checkpoints (cannot skip). Evolve Track A triggers at >=2 workflow uses. Agent E convergence architecture for large L3 tasks.

v6.3: Honest audit - removed facade capabilities (ACH/Bayesian), mandatory Knowledge Gap Scan table, conditional iterative loop (max 2 rounds), explicit Quality Gate STOP checkpoints, Evolve Track A triggers at >=2 uses, created framework-check.cjs
v6.2: Elevated Time Awareness to Prime Directive #5 - mandatory time verification before ANY temporal claim. Fixed incident where afternoon was stated at 11 AM.
v6.1: Agent E convergence architecture - isolated session for large L3 synthesis, ima-upload.cjs integration, context-aware shunt conditions. Matches SOP Agent E section.
v6.0: Full English localization, version bump
v5.6精炼版: 结构优化4041→2305字节，能力零丢失
融合date-utils(时间感知)+multi-search(迭代研究循环),精简技能体系
v5.4 方向A自动技能生成增加具体检测标准（同类反复/可标准化/边界情况），不再模糊跳过
v5.4 扬取舍并：Evolve层统一进化循环——将自动技能生成(对外)与自我改进(对内)合并为统一的Unified Learning Loop，减少概念碎片。其他4层保持精华不丢失

v5.3 更新：⑤Evolve层新增自我改进循环(Self-Improvement Loop)，合并openclaw-self-improvement核心能力——结构化学习记录(log-learning)+重复检测+自动推广(promote-learning)+实验验证(log-experiment)。迁入scripts: log-learning.mjs, promote-learning.mjs, log-experiment.mjs | references: schema.md, promotion-guide.md, eval-loop.md
v5.2 更新：④Evolve层新增自动技能生成机制（Auto-Skill Generation，借鉴Hermes Agent）——工具调用≥5次时自动检测可复用模式并生成SKILL.md草稿
